text:
Nina: Customer Lumina asks to extend a pin while they finish a staged rewrite. They requested up to 75 days and want credits. Can we prototype a "migration-lane" we can reuse? cc @Ravi @Casey
Ravi: What's their pinned model and traffic shape? Need baseline perf and semantic deltas.
Nina: Pinned to rwd-13b-quant, ~80QPS with a heavy EU tail. Preliminary canary: semantic delta ~3.8% (on their seed set) and p95 +7ms in eu-west. Embedding recall@10 down ~2pp.
Casey: 3.8% is above our recovery gate for tier-1. Idea: a reusable lane that supports three modes: short-bridge (14d, no credit), runway-30 (30d, 10% credit), runway-75 (75d, 18% credit + weekly audit). Each lane comes with a defined checklist and templated comms.
Jordan: Ops notes: require a shadow-serve period (traffic duplicated to new variant) for 48-72h with full telemetry before any bump. Add automatic rollback webhook and canary sequencer (5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%).
Ravi: Draft preflight checklist:
- customer seed eval (semantic + structured-output invariants)
- embedding similarity (median cosine delta + recall@k)
- perf smoke (p50/p95 vs baseline)
- shadow-serve telemetry pass (48h)
- KV-cache warm/cold scenarios
- fallback variant exercised
Casey: Add contract/legal snippet: credit accounting, explicit rollback window, and renewal/extension terms. Finance sign-off required for credits >15%.
fiscal-bot: Reminder: discounts over 15% require finance approval and a PR to billing-ops.
Nina: Action items: (1) Casey to draft lane doc + comms template, (2) Ravi to build shadow-serve automations and rollback webhook, (3) Jordan to prototype canary sequencer job. Target internal draft in 4 days; customer expects a firm answer in 9 business days.
Casey: I'll include sample SLOs: semantic-delta gate (<=2% for 30d, <=3% for 75d with remediation), perf gate (p95 <= baseline +10ms), and weekly trend check for runway>30d.
Ravi: I'll add an ops playbook section for emergency-pin rollback and a checklist for on-call handoff.
Nina: Good. We'll review in product sync and then route to finance/legal if needed. Keep messages short so CS can forward. :hourglass:
